note: Startup co-founder and 14-year military veteran, so 'successful' holds, and health is plainly the neglected corner — mornings and evenings go to the kids, the day goes to work, and his own body came last. But 'makes good money' is unevidenced and actively contradicted by the behaviour — sticker shock at $6,000, a spousal budget gate, an immediate 2 x $3,000 split and a tax write-off pitch. And the trajectory is rescue, not good-to-great: he peaked at 256 lb, described self-loathing and is at 232 lb with MRI-documented spinal degeneration. The rep verbally converted him into an ICP fit — 'you've already done the hard part... now it's just optimization' — which is a reframe of the prospect to match the ICP rather than an assessment of him against it.
